title: Q9
description:
“Let all the angels of God worship Him.”
Read: Deut 32:36–43, Psa 97:7
a) The NKJV of Deut 32:43 begins “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.” The line Hebrews quotes comes from the longer form of that verse in the Greek Old Testament (also found among the Dead Sea Scrolls). In the Song of Moses, who is being worshipped, and what is He doing at that moment (avenging His servants, providing atonement for His land and people)?
b) Psa 97:7 says: “Worship Him, all you gods.” What does Hebrews claim about the Son by taking worship owed to Yahweh in His day of judgment and directing it to the Son?
